**About The Role**
 Join Intel's graphics software team and help deliver high\-quality GPU experiences in AI domain.
   

  

 As a
 **GPU Software Engineer,** 
 you will develop, validate, debug, and optimize graphics software and GPU driver solutions across Intel platforms. You will work at the intersection of software and hardware, partnering with engineering teams to bring new graphics capabilities to market and solve complex system\-level issues.
   

  

 This is an opportunity to develop hands\-on expertise across GPU architecture, graphics drivers, validation, debugging, performance, compute, and AI workloads.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Key responsibilities will include but not limited to:**
* Develop and execute end\-to\-end validation solutions for GPU software, graphics drivers, and applications.
* Debug and resolve complex software, driver, and system\-level issues impacting GPU functionality, quality, and performance.
* Triage defects, perform root\-cause analysis, and collaborate with software and hardware engineering teams to drive issues to resolution.
* Develop and maintain software, automation, and debugging tools that improve validation efficiency and product quality.
* Analyze cross\-component interactions and identify potential quality, performance, and compatibility issues.
* Perform validation, triage, and debugging of GPU compute drivers, runtime layers, and AI framework integration failures across software and hardware teams.
* Integrate latest AI features into end\-to\-end validation flows and analyze cross\-component interactions to develop robust test scenarios.
* Develop and maintain automation tools, benchmarking suites, and frameworks to improve validation and debug efficiency across AI compute and runtime components.
* Optimize software performance, memory efficiency, and quality for emerging AI workloads, deep learning inference, and agentic applications.
* Enable and validate forthcoming AI hardware acceleration capabilities for Intel's GPU platforms.
* Collaborate on cross\-OS software development and validation for GPU\-accelerated AI and machine learning workloads.


**Behavioral Traits That We Are Looking For**
* Technical curiosity: Motivated to understand how software, GPU hardware, drivers, operating systems, and applications interact.
* Problem\-solving: Uses structured analysis and data to troubleshoot complex technical issues and identify root causes.
* Proactive ownership: Identifies potential issues or opportunities early, takes initiative, and follows problems through to resolution.
* Collaboration: Works effectively across software, hardware, validation, and architecture teams to solve cross\-functional problems.
* Communication: Clearly communicates technical findings, risks, and recommendations to technical stakeholders.
* Learning agility: Quickly learns new GPU architectures, graphics technologies, tools, APIs, and development environments.
* Quality mindset: Demonstrates attention to detail and considers product quality, reliability, performance, and the end\-user experience when making technical decisions.
* Adaptability: Effectively manages changing requirements and priorities in a fast\-paced engineering environment

**Overview**
Seeking a Software Engineer who thrives on solving complex technical problems in large-scale enterprise applications. **What You Will Do**

* Provides periodic updates to customers, co-workers & management on the status of outstanding issues.

* After gaining experience with the product, will have the opportunity to contribute with product enhancement development work.
* Assists team members with complex issues to gain experience & exposure to more advanced problems.
* Ability to navigate large, unfamiliar codebases quickly using AI tools — assessing defect blast radius and identifying the safest fix path with confidence.
* Contributes, reviews & maintain knowledge base content and product documentation as needed
* Will require periodic after hour / weekend coverage, done on a Pager rotational basis.
* Other duties may be assigned.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 2-5 yrs of software engineering.
* Excellent communication (oral & written), analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* OS experience in one or more areas of Linux, UNIX, and/or Windows.
* Frameworks: Java, J2EE, Servlets, MDB, HTML, JNDI, Jax-RS, JMS, Junit, XML, JSON
* Protocols: AS2/4, HTTP(S), FTP(S), SFTP, Rest/APIs, RNIF, EBICS
* Cloud experience in one or more areas of AWS, Azure, Google, IBM, RedHat.
* CI/CD: Maven, Docker, IBM Cloud, Kubernetes, Jenkins, GitHub
* Database experience in one or more areas of Oracle and/or DB2 and/or MS SQL and/or MySQL
* Ability to read and code through an Object Oriented Language, preferred Java.
* Experience with JDBC, JDK, JVM stack traces.
* Strong understanding & experience of executing Static & Dynamic scans, fixing vulnerabilities.
* Aptitude to prioritize and handle multiple issues simultaneously.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Ability to work independently in a fast paced environment.
* Ability to function and contribute in a team environment.
* AI Augmented Engineering & Debugging
* Demonstrated experience using AI assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) to accelerate debugging, root cause analysis, code remediation, and test generation within enterprise SDLC and security guardrails
* Spec Driven & Agent Assisted Development Practices
* Hands on experience with spec driven or agent assisted development workflows, including translating problem statements into clear specifications, guiding AI tools to generate targeted code changes, and validating outputs through tests and reviews

Working closely with the simulation, data, hardware, and systems teams, this engineer will take manipulation policies from demonstration data through post-training to robust deployment across our fleet.

Drive the development cycle from simulation and offline evaluation to robustly transferring and fine-tuning policies on the robot.

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE
